_comment: Hand-curated data. Always wins over scraped values for the same hero/pair. Edge scale 0..5 (>=4 hard counter). lane_tips are advice for playing AGAINST that hero.

counters.reason: Passive cuts Yu Zhong's sustain and his shield mitigates dragon form damage.
Suppression ignores his CC immunity in Black Dragon form.
Armor layers absorb Sha Essence trades and Firaga out-sustains him early.

lane_tips: Avoid trading when his Sha Essence bar is full — back off until it decays.
Rush anti-heal (Sea Halberd / Dominance Ice) early; without it he out-sustains every trade.
His ultimate is CC-immune once transformed — land stuns before the cast, or use suppression (Kaja, Franco, Akai).

counters.reason: Baxia's passive reduces her shield regen and heal to a fraction.
Burns through her shield with sustained true-damage-like pressure.

lane_tips: Anti-heal items also reduce her shield absorption — buy Sea Halberd / Dominance Ice first.
Her shield converts yours: do not stack shields against her.
Spread out so her Frostmoon Shield does not refresh off multiple targets.
Stand beside your minions — his Thorned Rose cannot be cast through the same target twice.
Wind of Nature or Antique Cuirass; his burst is pure physical.
He is immune only during Phantom Execution — bait it, then lock him down.
Hug walls she needs for cables; stand at awkward angles to deny chain cables.
Lock-on CC (Franco, Khufra, Kaja) and Wind Talker-free early game shut her out.
Ward the jungle entrances — her power is early tempo, so track and invade.
His ultimate and skill 2 give CC immunity — hold your stun until after his dash.
Ranged poke wins: he needs three skill-1 kicks to knock you up.
Do not stand near walls — the ult-kick into terrain extends his combo.
Trade when his stance bar is empty; he wins any 3-stack exchange.
Keep the wave mid-lane so he cannot knock you into tower.
Buy Antique Cuirass; his combo is multiple physical hits.
He wins at low HP thresholds; back before 40% so his ult cannot execute you.
Dodge the second part of skill 1 with a sidestep — it is where his damage is.
His skills reduce physical defense: stack HP (Thunder Belt, Guardian Helmet) instead of pure armor.
